title: From Efficiency to Sufficiency: The Cost-Aware Measurement Design Framework for Automated Essay Scoring
abstract: arXiv:2610.19287v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Compute cost in automated essay scoring (AES) is usually treated as a technical efficiency issue rather than a measurement design concern. Yet deployment decisions require more than reporting latency, model size, or inference expense. In high-stakes settings, total burden includes validation, monitoring, adjudication, compliance, and governance; in instructional settings, pricing, licensing, and integration may dominate cost. This paper reframes AES as a cost-constrained measurement system and introduces the Cost-Aware Measurement Design (CAMD) Framework, a four-layer structure consisting of metering, allocation, unit economics, and decision, for translating computational and workflow resource records into decision-relevant cost constructs. translated_title: 从效率到充分性：自动作文评分的成本感知测量设计框架
translated_abstract: 摘要：在自动作文评分（AES）中，计算成本通常被视为技术效率问题，而非测量设计问题。然而，部署决策所需的远不止报告延迟、模型大小或推理开销。在高风险场景中，总负担包括验证、监控、裁决、合规与治理；在教学场景中，定价、许可与集成可能主导成本。本文将AES重新构建为一个成本受限的测量系统，并引入成本感知测量设计（CAMD）框架——一个由计量、分摊、单位经济学和决策组成的四层结构，用于将计算与工作流资源记录转化为与决策相关的成本构念。直接成本被规定为货币支出加上可归因的劳动力和时间，而设计归因和可审计性这两项标准决定了成本边界所排除的内容。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出成本感知测量设计（CAMD）框架，将自动作文评分从单纯的技术效率问题重新构建为成本受限的测量系统，通过计量、分摊、单位经济学和决策四层结构，将计算与工作流资源记录转化为可直接支持部署决策的成本构念。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Cost-Aware Measurement Design (CAMD) Framework, a four-layer structure of metering, allocation, unit economics, and decision, which reframes automated essay scoring as a cost-constrained measurement system by translating computational and workflow resource records into decision-relevant cost constructs.
